source_title: Who are the youngest players in the WPL 2027 auction? All you need to know - Sportstar
source_excerpt: Chennai Delhi Capitals secured the services of 15-year-old Uma Kashvi for her base price of Rs. 10 lakh at the Women’s Premier League (WPL) 2027 auction in Kochi on Wednesday. The right-arm spin-bowling all-rounder from Karnataka initially attracted no bids, but Delhi Capitals made a late move to sign the youngster for Rs. 10 lakh. WPL auction: 5 uncapped Indian players to watch out for WPL auction: 5 uncapped Indian players to watch out for With 97 uncapped Indian players in the auction pool and 20 Indian slots available, Vrinda Dinesh, Gongadi Trisha and Sujata Dey are among the names to watch at the WPL 2027 mini auction in Kochi. WPL Auction: 5 uncapped Indian players to watch out for storyline 1 Kashvi featured in the recent India Under-19 versus Sri Lanka Under-19 series, taking four wickets in three T20 matches and two more in two one-day games. Born on April 9, 2011, Kashvi entered the auction as the youngest player on the list. Delhi’s Anshu Nagar, born on January 26, 2011, is the other 15-year-old in the auction.
